acquisition_method.evidence: Mass spectrometers were operated in the data-dependent mode.

alkylation_concentration.evidence: Samples were lysed in SDS-PAGE loading buffer, reduced with 1 mm DTT for 10 min at 95 °C and alkylated using 5.5 mm iodoacetamide for 30 min at 25 °C in the dark.

alkylation_reagent.evidence: Samples were lysed in SDS-PAGE loading buffer, reduced with 1 mm DTT for 10 min at 95 °C and alkylated using 5.5 mm iodoacetamide for 30 min at 25 °C in the dark.

cleavage_agent.evidence: Gel pieces were dried and 50 μl of 12.5 ng/μl trypsin (MS grade, Promega, Mannheim, Germany) were added.

collision_energy.evidence: The normalized collision energy was set to 35% at a target value of 5000.
